channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire

item.title: TIMELINE - AI at center of October cyberattack wave targeting tech giants, developer platforms
item.description: Anadolu Ajansı: Anadolu timeline recaps October cyberattacks in which AI played a central role against tech giants and developer platforms.

item.title: New ChatGPT Phishing Kit Uses Rotating WordPress Websites to Steal Payment Details and OTPs
